subject: Acme Corp POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme-corp.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the Acme team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same expectations going into the POC.

TL;DR (what we heard)
- Pain points: high and inconsistent inference latency at peak, unpredictable unit costs across models, and vendor lock-in concerns for multi-cloud deployments.
- Goals: demonstrate a ~40% reduction in per-token cost for your customer-facing summarization endpoint; p95 latency <200ms for 512-token requests under a realistic load; and validate quality via your prompt set/eval suite.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks)
- Models: evaluate 2 candidate open models (Redwood-verified profiles) for cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.
- Workloads: run against the provided sample dataset and the 25 prompt test set you shared.
- Metrics: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, and automated quality score (BLEU/ROUGE + human pass/fail on 50 samples).
- Integrations: test the hosted endpoint and a Dedicated-like config (reserved capacity) to compare economics.

Owners & roles
- Marissa Cole (Account Manager) — overall POC lead, timeline, commercial questions.
- Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer) — technical lead, integration support, eval automation.
- Rishi Malhotra (Platform/Infra) — will coordinate any VPC/network setup and performance tuning.

Timeline (proposed)
- Prep & access: by Mon Aug 24
- Kickoff & environment setup: Mon Aug 24 — 60 min virtual meeting
- Run experiments: Aug 25–Sep 3
- Review results & recommendations: Fri Sep 4

Immediate action items for Acme
1) Provide access: IAM role or temporary AWS creds for the test account (see redwood-access-instructions.txt attached).
2) Share the finalized prompt set (25 items) and a 500–1,000-item sample dataset for load testing.
3) Confirm kickoff time on Mon Aug 24 (suggested 9:00 AM PT).

Attachments: ACME_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (scope & success criteria), redwood-access-instructions.txt (how to create the IAM role)

If this matches your expectation, reply to confirm kickoff time and the contact who will provide the AWS access. Happy to adjust the timeline if you need more prep time.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:
- Security/compliance: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an outline of audit logging for the POC. Also, VPC peering or PrivateLink for the Dedicated test is required. Can Rishi share the network/config requirements?
- Success metrics: we're comfortable with the quality evaluation approach. For latency, our initial internal target is p95 <250ms at our 50% traffic simulation. If you can meet <200ms that's ideal but we can call out 250ms as acceptable threshold for the first run.
- Cost target: aim for ~35–40% reduction vs our current managed endpoint spend; we'll validate on the same workload.

Kickoff time: Mon Aug 24 at 9:00 AM PT works for our team. Attendees: Jamie Lee (product lead), Carlos Mendes (infra), Priya N. (data ops) — Priya will send the dataset and prompt set by Fri Aug 21.

I've attached our network diagram (acme-network-diagram.pdf) and I'll ask security to share the SOC 2 snapshot via the SSO portal — will follow up separately.

See quoted items below.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Quick prep checklist from the SE side before the kickoff (short list so Priya/Carlos can action quickly):

1) Credentials
- If using IAM role: provide VPC ID + CIDR and confirm peering preference.
- If using temp creds: send access via your secure channel.

2) Sample prompts & dataset
- Please drop the 25-item prompt set and a 500–1,000 record sample dataset into the Drive folder (or share a presigned S3 link).
- Also include 3–5 edge-case prompts (long inputs, many instructions) so we can exercise KV cache behavior.

3) Evaluation rubric
- We will run automated ROUGE + a simple pass/fail on 50 human-annotated samples. If you have a custom scoring script, please attach it.

4) Networking
- If you have an internal firewall, open outbound to the Redwood egress IP range (listed in the access doc).

5) Point of contact during runs
- Please share a Slack/Teams handle for the engineer who will be available during the runs (we typically request 1–2 hours on day 1 of runs).

I'll bring the eval scripts to the kickoff and can demo a quick run using a smaller subset. If useful, I can also pre-run a smoke test once access is provided.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
